Code of ConductA Paladin swears an oath: their god's tenets plus one personal vow. A flagrant breach Strains their god's favour; a second, or abandoning their god, makes them Forsaken until they atone. A Forsaken Paladin loses Channel Divinity, Lay on Hands, Spell Use, the auras, Divine Protection, Blessed Weapon, the Divine Mount and the deity's granted power; they keep their Hit Points, Base to Hit, weapon and armour training and Extra Attack (see Divine Favour in Book II).
IdentityA holy champion whose smites heal a friend as they wound a foe, whose presence shields allies, and whom fear and sickness cannot touch.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Divine Protection

  • Effect: +2 AC and +2 on all saves against evil creatures; this does not stack with Protection from Alignment. A summoned or conjured evil creature makes a Will save against your Class Save DC the first time each encounter it tries to touch you; on a failure it recoils and its attack misses.
  • Immune to disease.
  • Detect Evil: concentrate for one round while facing a target within 60ft. Usable as often as desired.

Guided Hand

  • Effect: Add your Charisma modifier to your first attack roll each round. Always on.

Channel Divinity (Charisma)

  • Effect: Uses per day equal to your Charisma modifier + 2 (minimum 3), +1 at 5th level and again at 15th (see the Paladin Progression Table). Your Channel options:
  • Smite (the default): spend a use when you hit (not before rolling).
  • The hit deals extra radiant damage equal to your Paladin level, and one ally within 10ft regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
  • Your first hit each encounter Smites automatically unless you choose to save the use.
  • Smite can be used against any foe, regardless of alignment.
  • One Smite a round; Blessed Weapon adds to it. 5th level: your Smite also deals +1d8 radiant damage (2d8 from 13th)

Lay on Hands

  • Effect: Each day you have a pool of healing equal to 2 HP per Paladin level. As an action, touch a creature and spend any number of points to heal it that much. Split the pool between creatures and uses as you like.
  • Cure Disease: spend 5 points to cure any disease by touch, no check required
  • 10th level: once per day you may Lay on Hands on a dying ally within your aura without touching it; from 18th this ends one condition

2nd Level

Auras

  • Effect: Aura of Courage: you are immune to the Frightened and Terrified conditions. Allies within your aura have Advantage on saves against fear. The aura reaches 10ft, 30ft from 15th and 50ft from 20th (see the Paladin Progression Table).
  • Aura of Devotion (9th): an ally in your aura who is Frightened or Charmed saves again at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
  • Aura of Resolve (17th): you and allies in your aura have Advantage on saves against Paralysed and Stunned.

3rd Level

Channel: Turn Undead

  • Effect: A new Channel option, used as your action: as the Cleric's Turn Undead (its Turning Radiance, its 60ft reach from 12th and an Evil Cleric's control carry over; the deity's favour does not), but counting as a Cleric 2 levels lower than your Paladin level. The Turn DC is your Class Save DC.
  • A 3rd level Paladin turns as a 1st level Cleric, a 5th level Paladin as a 3rd level Cleric, and so on
  • Destruction applies from 8th effective turning level, if the undead's Level is no more than half that level

4th Level

Divine Mount

  • Effect: Call a divinely-blessed warhorse (medium-sized Paladin) or war pony (small-sized Paladin): exceptionally intelligent, strong, and loyal.
  • It uses the Warhorse, Light (or Warpony) statistics in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue, with maximum HP: it doesn't kick or bite, but Tramples a Prone creature.
  • It has 24 HP plus twice your Paladin level, uses your saves when they are better, and obeys you as a controlled mount with no check.
  • If it dies, you may call another after a month

5th Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Begins casting divine spells per the Paladin Spells Per Day table. Charisma is your casting stat; your spell save DC is your Class Save DC.

Blessed Weapon

  • Effect: One hit of your choice each round deals an extra 1d6 radiant damage; it adds to a Smite. Your weapon counts as magical for overcoming resistance.

6th Level

Channel: Heaven's Answer

  • Effect: A new Channel option, costing 2 uses: call on your deity for one of these effects.
  • (1) Right after the roll, reroll one d20 or damage roll of your own; you can do this out of turn
  • (2) When you take damage: halve it, and all further damage you take until the start of your next turn; you can do this out of turn
  • 8th level: (3) as your action, by touch: end every disease and the Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, Charmed, Frightened and Confused conditions on one creature

7th Level

  • Extra Attack: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

15th Level

  • Charisma Bonus: permanent +1 Charisma. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

20th Level

Renown: Holy Order

  • Effect: You may found a chapter house (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d6 lay brothers and one 1st-level Paladin of your god join it. While you hold it, once per month you may call on your god's Divine Will: up to your Paladin level in creatures that can hear your voice, none of Level above half yours, make a Will save against your Class Save DC or takes up a cause you name, as under a Geas, for days equal to your Paladin level.
  • Divine Will does not affect inherently evil creatures or player characters

24th Level

Cleanse Soul

  • Effect: Once per week, as your action, touch one creature.
  • It makes a Will save against your Class Save DC.
  • On a failure, every charm, curse, enchantment and possession on it ends and lycanthropy is cured; a fiend or undead is destroyed if its Level is no more than half your Paladin level, and otherwise takes radiant damage equal to twice your Paladin level and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
  • On a success it takes half that damage.
  • Either way you learn its Allegiance and any charm, curse or possession on it, and you gain one level of Exhaustion.

Kits: Deity-Based

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Paladin folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Paladin Kits follow the same deity structure as Cleric Kits: each Kit is tied to a specific deity whose cause you champion.
  • Paladin Granted Powers lean martial rather than priestly: blessings for the champion, not the congregation.
  • Most deities grant one daily power; a few improve a class feature instead.
  • Each god's tenet is in the Cleric's deity tables.
  • Your god's favoured weapon is your holy symbol.
  • A once-a-day power that rolls dice for damage or healing gains one more die at 5th, 11th and 17th level, as a cantrip does.

The Tarielian Pantheon

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
Lathander (The Dawning Light)Mace, HeavyOnce/day: when your Smite hits an undead creature, it must make a Will save against your Class Save DC or be destroyed outright rather than just damaged, if its Level is no higher than your Paladin level. Advantage on saves vs necromantic effects.
Chauntea (The Earth's Bloom)SickleAdvantage on Nature checks. Once/day, when your Smite hits, roots burst up around the target: it and each enemy within 10ft of it make a Fortitude save or are Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
Eldath (The Verdant Peace)StaffAdvantage on saves vs charm and enchantment. Once/day, as an action: each hostile creature within your Aura of Courage (10ft before 2nd level) makes a Will save or is calmed for 1 minute: it takes no hostile action; harming it or its allies ends the calm.
Sune (The Full Bloom)WhipAdvantage on Persuasion and Performance. Lay on Hands also ends the Charmed condition. Once/day, your Smite's healing reaches every ally within 10ft instead of one.
Lliira (The Heart of Joy)DartYou have Aura of Devotion from 1st level. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for the encounter.
Selûne (The Moonlit Veils)MorningstarAdvantage on Insight checks. Once/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it. A creature your Smite hits makes a Will save or cannot act out of turn until the end of its next turn.
Tymora (The Fortunate Harvest)Sword, ShortAdvantage on initiative. Once/day, reroll an attack you missed; if it then hits, it Smites without spending a use.
Brigh (The Crafted Turn)Hammer, LightAdvantage on Craft and Smith checks. Once/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Your Divine Mount wears god-forged barding: +2 AC, and its hits deal +1d6 fire damage.
Torm (The Enduring Duty)GreatswordAura of Courage reaches 30ft from 1st level, and 20ft further than the table from 15th. Once/day: all allies within 30ft can't be Frightened for the encounter and regain HP equal to your Charisma modifier.
Helm (The Vigilant End)Sword, Bastard+1 AC while using a shield. Once/day: for the encounter, attacks against a touched creature have Disadvantage.
Tyr (The Winter's Justice)Hammer, WarOnce/day: bind a target to a sworn oath (Will save negates). A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Advantage on Persuasion when enforcing a contract or vow. Your Smite binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
Ilmater (The Winter's Solace)CestusYour Lay on Hands pool is 4 HP per Paladin level instead of 2. Once/day: Lay on Hands also ends Poisoned at no cost; from 8th, Heaven's Answer's third option at no cost.

MaskSword, ShortAdvantage on Stealth and sleight of hand. Once/day, while in shadow: you are Invisible until the end of your next turn. A Smite you make while Hidden doesn't reveal you.

MoradinHammer, WarAdvantage on Perception checks underground or in stone structures. While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will. Once/day, when your Smite hits, the stone heaves: the target makes a Fortitude save or is knocked Prone.

BahamutGlaiveChoose acid, cold, fire or lightning at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it, and your Smite deals +1d6 damage of that type. Advantage on saves against breath weapons.

Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher)Sword, BastardAura of Courage reaches 10ft further. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead, reduced by your Charisma modifier.

The Elemental Lords

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AkadiFlail, HeavyAdvantage on saves vs weather and elemental effects. Once/day, when your Smite hits, lightning strikes the target for +3d6 lightning damage.
GrumbarClubWhile you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will. When your Smite hits, the ground within 20ft of you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn.
IstishiaHammer, WarAdvantage on Swim checks, and you and your Divine Mount can hold your breath ten times as long. Once/day, when your Smite hits, a surge of water pushes the target and each creature within 10ft of it 10ft away (Fortitude save negates the push).
KossuthFlail, LightSmite deals additional +1d6 fire damage. Once/day: create a 15ft cone of fire (2d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves vs cold.

Evil Deities

  • Paladins of an evil deity (the Evil Deities table, plus Lolth, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet and Tiamat): Divine Protection, Detect Evil and Cleanse Soul work against good creatures instead (celestials in place of fiends). Their oath follows that god's tenets, and betraying the patron makes them Forsaken at once.
DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AsmodeusSword, RapierOnce/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates). A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. When your Smite hits, offer terms to the creature: it makes a Will save or cannot attack you until your next turn.
BaneMorningstarAdvantage on Intimidation. Once/day, when your Smite hits, every enemy within 15ft of you makes a Will save or is Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
BhaalDaggerOnce/day: if the target is below half HP, your Smite's hit deals maximum weapon damage (no roll). Advantage on Perception checks against wounded or fleeing creatures.
CyricSword, ShortAdvantage on Deception, and you can Feint as the Feint feat describes. Your Smite against a creature you have Feinted this encounter deals +1d6 damage.
MyrkulScytheYour Turn Undead may control undead as an Evil Cleric's does. Once/day: cast Speak with Dead without a slot.
SharDaggerAdvantage on Stealth in darkness. Once/day: snuff all nonmagical light within 30ft for 10 minutes. Your Smite against a creature in darkness deals +1d6 necrotic damage.
Shune the VileDaggerAdvantage on checks to conceal true intent, and on initiative. Once/day, when your Smite hits, plant a false memory in the target (Will save negates).
AurilAxe, BattleSmite deals additional +1d6 cold damage and halves target's movement speed for 1 round. Resistance 5 to cold damage.
Tharizdun (The Chained God)Improvised weaponAdvantage on unsettling-presence Intimidation. Once/day, when your Smite hits, the target makes a Will save or is Stunned for 1 round.
UmberleeTridentAdvantage on Swim and water-based checks. Once/day, when your Smite hits, a wave breaks over the target and a 15ft line behind it: each creature there makes a Fortitude save or is pushed 15ft and knocked Prone.
  • All other archdevils and demon lords (Mephistopheles, Orcus, Graz'zt, Demogorgon, Baphomet, Yeenoghu) are Warlock patrons, not Paladin gods.
